tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog mi pham mgon pos dri ba snga phyir mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bkod pa bzhugs so// 462)bstan pa'i bstan 'dzin padma'i snying po las// sprul mdzad sprul pa'i rgyud 'dzin gangs ri'i khrod// grangs mang grangs kyi nang nas mchog gyur rje// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skyabs mgon gang de'i drung*// zhu mchid snyan ngag nyams 'gyur gyis dben kyang*// grangs med bskal pa'i gong nas bzod pa'i rgyud// rab goms byams thugs 'khrel ba mi mnga' phyir// 'dod don tshig 'ga' snyan du gsol bar bgyi// chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin rang sems dang*// gnyis su med par gsungs kyang ma 463)rig pas// bsgribs te the tshom gyur rnams dri tshig tu// yi ger phul la brtson bas gzigs par gsol/ ༈ de la thog mar/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i smin byed dbang gi skabs su/ gang zag gi snod dang skal ba'i khyad kyis/ dbang po rab tu gyur pa'i rigs la ye shes dbab pa tsam gyis dbang bzhi stan thog gcig la thob par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bring la bum dbang tsam bskur bas smin pa dang*/ tha ma tsam la dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa thob pas rgyud smin par gsungs pa de'i don hril gyi 464) dril na/ rgyud sde rnams dgongs pa mthun phyir/ bde mchog lta bu la mtshon na/ mthar thug gi rdo rje phag mo ni rang gi sems nyid spros pa dang bral ba 'di yin te/ 'di nyid shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'ang yin no/ zhes dang*/ gzhan yang skyes bu thabs te sems shes rab/ ces dang*/ mig ni thabs te gzugs shes rab/ sogs dang*/ snang ba yab la stong pa yum/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs te/ dbang bzhi'i don ni zung 'jug gi ye shes nyid kho nar bshad na/ ding sang ni/ dbang gsum pa'i nyams len am zhig yin zer nas/ phyag rgya brtag pa/ dgug pa/ sgrib pa/ smin par bya ba sogs kyi rim pa ji bzhin ni lta zhog

dbab bskyil zlog dgram sogs gang la yang rang dbang spu rtse tsam ma thob pa'i/ mgo sog sgab rdum pho mo zung du bsdebs nas 'jig rten gyi khams kun myul 465) zhing*/ chos min mi byed pa'i bya ba sna gcig kyang med cing*/ zhe sdang gi sprin nag las rdod byug gi thog ser phabs te/ khyim sgo dang srang khyams kun thal bar rlog pa 'di 'dra ba mang po mthong ba'i rgyus/ rgyal bstan gyi nyi ma chu lha'i ri phag tu gshegs par go ste/ yi mug gi mun pa sangs dus kyi skal ba ma mchis pa dang*/ skabs 'gar ni/ rang sems rang 'tsho ma thub pa'i cho 'phrul du go ba zhig kyang shar bas/ des na dbang bzhi'i don gyi ngo bo dang dbye ba/ thob mtshams sogs kyi snying po'i 'gag don ltar lags/ ༈ grol byed khrid kyi skabs su/ phyi rol du sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung po 'di nyid gtso bor gyur pa'i dngos po ri rab khang khyim rtsi shing nags tshal 'byung lnga skye 'gro bde sdug gi yo lang thams cad dang*/ nang du dug lnga'am gsum las 466)skyes pa'i rnam par rtog pa phra rags mtha' dag rang sems kyi cho 'phrul nyid las gzhan ma yin par thag chod la rang sems de nyid kyi 'gyu ba'am rtog pa la 'khor ba dang*/ gnas pa'i mi rtog pa la myang 'das su bzhed pa dang*/ 'gyu ba nyid la'ang*/ dkar nag gnyis su snang bas/ gnyis ka 'khor ba'i rd+yu yin min the tshom du gyur pa dang*/ mi rtog pa'am gnas pa la yang zhi lhag gnyis su gsungs phyir/ gnyis ka myang 'das kyi rgyu dngos gzhir 'gyur ram mi 'gyur ji ltar lags/ yang sems kyi ngo bo nyid kyang skabs 'ga' zhig las ni/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab phar phyin du gsungs la/ skabs 'gar ni/ brjod pa kun gyi rgyu'i mchog tu gsungs pas 'gal 'du ji ltar lags dang*/ ༈ yang gnas skabs kyi 'char tshul du/ mig gi lta stangs nam mkhar gtad na sems 467)yang nam mkhar gnas la/ sa gzhir gtad na sa gzhir gnas pa/

gang du gnas pa'i yul de nyid dbyibs dang kha dog gi rnam par gsal yang der 'dzin dang bral ba/ gnas mal yang che na che gang zhing chung na chung gang ba lta bu la/ gnas mkhan kho rang gi ngo bo ni yod par yang brjod mi bde la med par yang brjod du mi bde ba zhig 'dug pa 'di nyid gnas pa'i mtshan nyid du 'gyur ram mi 'gyur ji ltar lags pa dang*/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ skad cig skad cig la gnas shing*/ skad cig skad cig la 'gyu ba 'gyu rjes su gnas pa de na bun yal ba 'dra ba/ gnas rjes su 'gyu ba de sprin gsar skyes pa 'dra ba/ de yang rkyen bzang ngan gang yang thug phrad kyi dus su glog 'khyug pa 'dra ba 'di nyid sgom gyi ngo bor rung ngam mi rung ji ltar dang*/ gal te de nyid rung na'ang*/ gnas 468)dus la bltas na rkyen gang byung thegs pa 'dra yang*/ rkyen dang phrad ma thag gnas pas mi sleb pa shas che bas na the tshom gyi gnas su gyur lags pa dang*/ lar yang*/ sgom gyi skabs 'di dag tu gang zhig sgom blo ma skyes par sgom 'byung ba ni dka' la/ skyes nas bsgom pa yang shin tu the tshoms te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa'i dbu ma rtsa ba shes rab las/ gang dag stong pa nyid blta ba// de dag gsor mi rung bar bshad/ ces pa'i don/ rje zla 'od gzhon nus dpe rigs lung gsum gyis bstan te/ dpe ni/ ji ltar nad pa la 'khru sman btang bas/ nad dang 'khru sman gnyis gang 'khrus pas ni nad pa gsor rung ba yin mod kyi/ nad 'khrus kyang bkru sman ma zhu na dug tu 'gyur bas nad pa gsor mi rung bas 'chi bar 469)'gyur ba'i dpe de bzhin du/ rigs pa'i gtan tshigs kyang*/ dngos por lta ba thams cad ni stong nyid bsgoms pas zhig kyang*/ stong pa nyid la zhen cing 'thas pa la ni gang gis kyang 'jig par mi nus te/ ngan 'gro log par ltung bar 'gyur ro/ de'i lung ni/ klu sgrub kyi rin chen 'phreng bar/ stong pa nyid la lta nyes na// shes rab chung rnams phung bar 'gyur/

zhes sogs gsungs pa dang*/ sgom blo skyor mi rung ba'i tshul yang*/ rgyal ba'i yum las/ rigs kyi bu/ gang yid la bya rgyu'i chos shig byung na de ni yang dag pa'i lta ba ma yin no/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang*/ stong nyid mtshan med bsgoms pas kyang ngan 'gror ltung ba de lta na/ mtshan bcas dmigs pa'i sgom kun gyis ci zhig 'gyur bar the tshom rab tu che bar mchis lags pa dang*/ ༈ 470)yang*/ dang po gang du'ang ma grub pa'i sems nyid 'di la/ dang po byung sa med/ bar du gnas sa med/ mtha' mar 'gro sa med pas skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral tshul bshad pa 'ba' shig gsung rab spyi dang bka' rgyud rin po che'i khrid dpe'i rigs thams cad mthun par byung rung*/ kun mkhyen rang byung zhabs kyi bstan bcos zab mo nang don gzhung 'grel gyi le'u gnyis pa lus sems grub tshul 'chad pa'i skabs su/ gsang sngags rnying ma'i lung 'dren mdzad par/ dwangs ma lnga 'dus kyi ye shes ni snying ga kho nar gnas tshul gsungs pa dang*/ da lta phal pa rnams kyi dran bsam phal cher yang snying nas 'phro 'du byed pa shas che ba 'dra zhig snang ba sogs la the tshom gyi gnas kho nar gyur pa zhig byung ba nas/ dogs gcod zhu ba'i yul du gyur pa yid 471)brtan thub pa'i gnas ni dus dbang gar yang dkon pa dang*/ rje nyid 'gro kun yongs kyi ched du mdzad pa'i sgrub pa'i me tog la bar chad kyi byang ljir 'gyur dogs na'ang*/ gser gling nas stong log gi 'jigs pas kun nas blangs te dri 'bul gyi yig gzugs 'phreng bar bkod de phul bar/ dmigs med thugs rje chen pos brtser gzigs kyis/ bdag blo rnam rtog gi thag hrul gcod pa'i dri lan ye shes kyi ral gri rig pa gcer mthong gi me 'od du 'bar ba zhig thugs rjes stsol bar gsol ba 'debs shing*/ bdag 'dra dal 'byor gyi lus rten tsam thob kyang las rlung gi shugs drag pos bskyod pas rang dbang rang gi 'du bar dka' zhing*/

gzhan phan gyi sa bon ni 'debs pa dang 'debs rgyu gnyis ka dben la/ rang don snying por mi med lung 472)stong rnams su grogs med gcig pu'i brtul zhugs kyi nyams bag yangs su rgyu ba la yid smon gyi 'dun pa gtad med du 'phyo na'ang*/ sngon bsags kyi bang mdzod stongs tshe snying stobs kyi 'byor pa dang bral/ yul dgon du btang snyoms su gnas pa 'di lta bur ni/ chos thog tu rkyen ngan shig gi so nad tsam yang mi theg bzhin du/ gshin po'i sgrib sbyong dang gson po'i tshogs yul du khas len zhing*/ gdos bcas kyi sgye'u dkor nag log 'tsho'i rdzas ngan gyis brgyang ba ni sems kyis mi bzod pa'i zug rngu rnga mo rnge'u stor ba ltar gyur pa'i mthus/ chos med par mi tshe ring po'i smon lam mi 'debs thag chod lags tshe/ mkhyen brtse ye shes kyi gzigs pas 'di bzung mthar thug byang chub kyi bar du 'dor med du gsol ba 'debs so zhes bam steng nges 'byung gi dgon 473)pa nas/ ser gzugs pa karma mi pham mgon pos phul ba'o// zhes pa 'di yan gyi dri lan du skal bzang dga' byed bdud rtsi'i 'dod 'jo zhes pa de nyid yin no// ༈ lags/ sngon gyi dus na mkhas pa g.yu thog mgon pos rgyud bzhi gsungs dus kyi dri ba dris lan ltar/ bdag 'dra ba'i 'gro ba gcig pu'i don du/ skal bzang dga' byed 'di ltar phebs pa'i bka' drin ni blo'i yul las 'das shing*/ 'dzam gling lan gsum bskor yang*/ sde snod rgyud sde gsar rnying kun gyi dgongs don gcig tu dril ba stan thog gcig kho nar rna bar thos pa'i skal ba ni da res las sngar phan ma mchis shing*/ slad mar byang chub kyi bar du yang zab don lta bu ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing*/ ji ltar bstan pa'i don ji bzhin khong du 474)chud pa dang*/ de yang tshig lta bu ma yin par/ brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su len pa skad cig kyang g.yel ba med pa'i smon lam gyi bsam sbyor sngon du btang nas/

slar yang snyan du gsol pa dang po bum dbang thob pa nas snod bcud thams cad lhar blta dgos shing*/ bum dbang nyid len par byed pa la'ang rang lus snang stong sgyu ma'i lhar ldang dgos pa dang*/ de las kyang gong du swa bha wa'i sngags don nas gzod ma nyid nas rnam par dag pa'i stong pa chen po nyid yin pa la yin par ngo shes dgos pa de lta na/ slob ma de sngar nas dbang bzhi pa'i don go ba zhig dgos par 'gyur la/ phyag bzhes kyi rim pa yang dang por shing bu rde'u sogs la brten pa'i zhi gnas dang mtshan med kyi zhi gnas sogs goms pa zhig la dbang bzhi bskur na legs par 'gyur gyi/ da lta 475)ni dbang sngon la bskur rjes khrid 'debs pa'i phyag bzhes dang*/ mtshan yang smin grol gnyis zhes smin byed sngon la nges par 'byung bas des na tshul 'di'i dgongs pa ji ltar lags/ ༈ dbang gsum pa yang*/ byang sems snying khar slebs pa tsam la bzlog dgram goms su bcug pa'i mthar nor bu'i rtse mor lhan skyes sam/ bde stong ngam/ bzhi pa'i don kho nas bskyil bar nus la/ sngon gyi skyes chen dag dbu brag phug la brdabs pa dang zhabs la tsher ma zug pa sogs kyang lhan skyes su 'char ba rnams dang mthun par 'gyur bar go yang*/ ding sang khrid dpe dang phyag bzhes dmar khrid thams cad du ni rtsa them rlung them kho na la gal po cher mdzad par grags la/ 'di la ni/ snyan rgyud rdo rje'i tshig rkang du/ gzhan dbang 'dod sred bag med chang gis myos/ 476)/don las nyams shing slar yang ngan song lhung*/ zhes dang*/ lung bstan dag tu'ang*/ 'og sdom khan la thabs lam shes so zer/ zhes gsungs pa ltar 'gyur bar go bas/ des na rtsa rlung them bu'i dgos pa dang dgongs don ji ltar lags pa dang*/ dbang bzhi pa'i mtshan la tshig dbang rin po che zhes 'dogs pa'i 'bru don nam nges tshig ci zhig lags/ ༈ yang*/ bum dbang gi lam skyed rim gyi skabs su brda don rtags gsum zhes pa de nyid gang dang gang lags pa dang*/

kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi 'dren tshul ji ltar bzhed pa lags/ ༈ dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob phyin chad skyed rdzogs gnyis kyang stan thog gcig la tshang bar nyams su len dgos par gsungs na/ bum dbang gis skyed rim bstan nas/ rdzogs rim bzhi pas shugs las bstan pa lags sam/ dngos ni dbang bzhis bstan par ma go zhing*/ lar/ skyed rdzogs gnyis 'di 477)rgya gar du yang paṇa grub so so'i bzhed tshul sna tshogs te/ thun stod thun smad so sor nyams su len pa'i lugs dang snga dro phyi dro dang nyin mtshan tha dad du dang*/ tshe stod tshe smad kyi nyams len du 'dod pa sogs mi mthun pa mang yang*/ na ro'i sgrub rgyud pa'i phyag bzhes la stan thog gcig tu bsgom par bzhed na/ de lta bu stan thog gcig la skyed rdzogs gnyis ka ma tshang na skyon dang nyes pa ci lta bu mchis pa lags/ rdzogs rim dngos kyang*/ de yang bdag gis ni bde mchog dril bu pa'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor du smin byed thob khul lags pa de'i bdag skyed kyi rdzogs rim ni nang gi he ru ka'i snying gar thig le yungs 'bru tsam la shes pa gtad tshul sogs dang*/ rdzogs rim dngos bstan ni/ phyi gzhal yas khang nang gi lha 'khor la sdu zhing*/ de gtso bo dang*/ de nyid hūm̐ dang*/ hūm̐ nā da la bsdus nas stong chen gyi dbyings su mnyam par 478) 'jog tshul sogs mtshan mo'i rnal 'byor du bstan byung zhing*/ yang*/ rje mi skyod zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i lha lnga par ni tshul 'di bdag skyed kyi rdzogs rim du bstan nas/ slar lhan skyes krong skyed kyi skur ldang ste thun mtshams kyi bya ba'i 'khor lo la 'jug thabs sogs/ 'di lta bu'i rigs can mi 'dra ba shin tu mang bas dgongs don rtogs dka' bar gyur tshe/ ji ltar lags pa dang*/ rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa mu tig 'phreng ba'i lha rnams ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon gang yin la bsdu zhing dmigs med kyi rgyas 'debs pa tsam las gzhan pa gang yang ma gsungs pas the tshom dang*/

gal te rgyud sde gong 'og gi khyad par yin na ni/ phyag rdor lta bu la mtshon na rnam 'joms ni bya rgyud kyi lhar bstan pa 'dra zhig la/ zla bzang ni dus 'khor gyi snod du gyur phyir the tshom 479)dang*/ de bzhin du/ rdor sems/ sgrol ma sogs mang por rgyud sde'i dbye ba dka' ba dang*/ he ru ka'i dbang la rdor sems kyi brtul zhugs bstan pa dang*/ rdor sems dang he ru ka gnyis ka'i brtul zhugs nyid kyi dgos don gang yin pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ chu gtor gyi bdag skyed spyan ras gzigs dang*/ bsangs kyi bdag skyed gu ru rin po che sogs mang por skyed rim gyi sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i spro sdu rnams mi snang ba'i dgongs don ci zhig yin pa dang*/ lha'i thugs srog sa bon gyi yi ge'i gdong de lha'i mdun phyogs su bstan dgos par gsungs mod kyi/ gdong de dpe cha'i ngos la yod skabs kyi/ rang la tshur lta ba de la ngos 'dzin nam yig mgo'i phyogs su lta ba la ngos 'dzin pa gang lags pa'i bzhed don rnams lhug par stsol ba mkhyen/ 480)༈ yang*/ skyed rdzogs gnyis ka'i srog shing lta bur gyur pa'i rtsa dbu ma 'di la/ gnas pa'i dbu ma dang*/ sgoms pa'i dbu ma gnyis kyi phyi ma ni khrid gzhung so so bzhin la/ gnas pa'i dbu ma ni/ rje rang byung zhabs kyis nang don du gsungs par/ mkhrang gyur zhag ni dang po nas// rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum gyi// tshad ldan dbu ma srog rlung bcas// a wa dhū tir shes bya ste// lhan cig skyes ster byed pa'o/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de'i 'grel par/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba ster ba ste/ mdor na lus can srog rtsa yin pas 'di go bar bya'o/ zhes lus can thams cad kyi srog rtsar gsungs na/ 'gro ba drug ka la yod par bzhed dam/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus gcig pu la yin nam ji ltar lags dang*/ bar do'i sems can rnams 'gro ba drug po'i khongs su 'du'am mi

481)'du ji ltar dang*/ gong gi 'phros las/ 'grel par/ 'khor lo drug po'i bar bar du sems can de nyid kyi rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum pa'i tshad kyi srog rtsa chags par 'gyur te/ rtse mo gcig ni rtsa dang 'brel lo/ zhes gsungs na/ 'di skabs mkhrang gyur gyi gnas skabs der sems can de nyid la yan lag gi gnas rnams su 'bur po lnga dod pa'i dus la'ang ma sleb par/ sor 'byung ba'i rgyu ma mchis pas na 'di'i dgongs pa gang zhig lags/ yang*/ sngar gyi mjug tu/ dri med 'od kyi lung yang*/ zla ba gcig nas byang chub kyi sems thams cad kyi myu gur gyur pa'i snying gi dbus kyi gnas su rtsa bcu srog rlung la sogs pa'i gzhir gyur pa shin tu phra ba skra'i tshad tsam mo/ zhes pas/ dbu ma dang srog rtsa gcig par bzhed cing*/ srog gi rlung 482)yang dbu ma'i nang du gnas par gsungs te/ srog rlung sgra gcan rang bzhin te/ dbu mar rgyal po lta bur gnas/ zhes dang*/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga 'chad pa'i skabs su yang*/ srog ni a wa dhū ti ste// gzhan ni rtsa ba'i rlung rgyu'i gnas/ zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha'i mgon po zhes bya ba// 'chi ba'i tshe na yang dag rgyu// da lta bdag 'dzin dran pa bskyed// log na brgyal smyo 'chi bar byed/ ces sogs gsungs phyir/ dbu ma las gzhan pa'i srog rtsa yod par ma gsungs par go yang*/ rgyal ba yang dgon pa chen pos mdzad pa'i rdo rje lus kyi sbas bshad du/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ srog gi dbug pa'i nang na gnas// sum cu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan// phra ba'i phra ba yang dag mchog /phyi rol ma yin nang ma yin/ zhes srog rtsa'i nang ngam mdun 483)du dbu ma/ g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang*/ de rnams kyi bar du rang sor re'i bar thag yod par bshad cing*/ srog rlung dbu mar gnas tshul gong ltar la/ srog rtsa ni stong par gnas gsungs snang bas na/ des na 'di gnyis kyi 'gal 'du ni/

srog rtsa dang dbu ma gcig dang tha dad pa'i khyad par dang*/ dbu ma'i dbyibs kyang*/ nang don las ni/ chu shing me tog ltar stong pa sogs dang*/ gzhan las dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan gyi skabs su yang*/ drang zhing 'khrengs pa chu shing gi sdong po lta bu/ zhes gsungs pa 'ba' shig byung ba las/ sbas bshad du ni/ sum cu rtsa gnyis mdud dang ldan par gsungs pas shin tu the tshom ches che bar byung lags pa dang*/ yang dgon pa'i lung khungs kyang*/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud las/ zhes pa/ rtsa mchog 'di dag ni bla med kyi mthar 484)thug pa'i sbas don bshad pa'i skabs yin tshe rnal 'byor yo ga'i rgyud kyi lung 'ong don ma mchis na/ ji ltar lags/ yang*/ mi pham padma dkar pos mdzad pa'i bsangs rab kyi chos skyong gi rtsa ba bshad skabs na/ nā ḍi dbu mar rengs pa'i gzugs/ zhes byung bas/ nā ḍi zhes pa srog gi rlung la 'jug mi 'jug dang*/ rengs pa dang log pa gnyis don gcig mi gcig ci lta bu lags/ srog gi rlung de nyid dbu ma'i nang du rang gang gi tshul du gnas par 'dod pa dang*/ gsum khyog a yig gi rnam par gnas zhes 'dod tshul tha dad du snang bas the tshom dang*/ dus 'khor gyi gzhung lugs ni/ srog rlung gi stod sgra gcan/ 'og dus mer bzhed cing*/ de la lte ba'i las rlung gi gso skyed la brten nas phyi rol gyi nyi zla gza' 'dzin 'byung bar gsungs snang bas/ de ltar na/ zla ba mjug 485)'dzin dang nyi ma la gdong 'dzin gtan mi srid pa'am/ yang na ni srog rlung nyid mgo mjug ldog dgos par 'gyur ba'i skyon dang*/ lar/ phyi rol zla drug gi nges pa 'di yang nang du las rlung gi gso skye las 'byung dgos par gda' yang*/ dus mtshams kyi gnad go bar dka' zhing the tshom che ba dang*/ 'ga' zhig gi gsung las ni/ dkar dmar gnyis snying khar 'dzom ste 'bros 'ded kyi tshul du bskor bas/ dkar pos dmar po zin dus nyi 'dzin 'ong tshul sogs gsungs gda' yang*/

de ltar na gnam gang la nyi zla lhan cig 'dzoms nas gcig gis gcig sgribs res byed dgos par 'gyur bas/ de ltar 'thad par mi sems shing zla drug gi nges pa yang stor bar 'gyur ba dang*/ khyad par du lte ba'i ro rkyang las bzhir gyes shing*/ 486)bzhi gsum gsum du gyes pa'i bcu gnyis po la/ skabs 'gar lug sogs mnyam pa'i khyim drug glang sogs mi mnyam pa'i khyim drug tu 'chad cing*/ skabs 'gar ni/ lug sogs mi mnyam pa dang glang sogs mnyam pa'i khyim du bshad pa 'di la/ dpal gtsug lag 'phreng ba lta bus kyang*/ tshul 'di dag sngon nas bris nor ram/ dgongs pa ci ltar yin ma shes tshe/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa sogs karma pa'i bstan 'dzin rnams kyi gtan la 'bebs par zhu zhes gsungs par mdzad na/ shin tu yang mgo 'khor ba'i gnas du snang ba dang*/ khyad par gnad don 'di'i skabs kyi byed pa las brten nas phyi rol gyi nyi ldog 'di 'byung rgyur snang yang*/ bdag ni phyi nang gnyis kar yang dam pa'i man ngag la mang thos 'byor pas dben zhing dpe la bltas pa tsam gyis phyi nang gi don 487)la go yul ma rnyed tshe the tshom gyi drwa ba chod thub pa'i bka' drin stsol ba zhu/ ༈ gzhan yang skal bzang dga' byed kyi phebs nang du/ dran pa rnam bkod kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i mdud pa hūm̐ gi dbyibs can/ zhes pa'i rtsa gsum po ni gtso bo gsum nyid yin shas che yang*/ slar dbus ma gsum chos nyid kyi rtsa/ zhes gsungs pa 'di gsum gyi bzhugs gnas go ma bde ba dang*/ mdun rtsa ye shes kyi rtsar gnas pa'i yid kyi rnam shes de la nyon mongs kyi dri ma yod med ji ltar dang*/ khyad par de dag gi dbus rtsa'i nang du dbu ma'i dngas ma ka ti shel gyi bu gu can nam/ mdud bral ma zhes bya ba 'di nyid/ yang dgon pa'i sbas bshad kyi srog rtsa dang dgongs pa gcig pa lags sam/ nang don du ni/

mdud bral ma yan lag gi 488)rtsa ru bshad nas gnas kyang lce'u chung gi dbus su zug par bstan pa'am/ lce chung gang yin yang the tshom dang*/ khyad par rtsa'i rgyal po ri bong mig dang 'di gnyis gcig mi gcig ji ltar lags/ yang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad kyi gnas dwangs ma brgyad kyi rtsa 'di dag dus 'khor sogs nas gsungs pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rtsa bcu po dang dgongs pa gcig gam tha dad lags dang*/ bcu po de rnams kyang rgyud sde gzhan rnams su ni dbu ma/ dung can ma/ snar ma/ glang chen lce/ khyab byed de rtsa ba'i lnga dang*/ yan lag gam sbas pa'i rtsa lnga ni/ sum skor ma/ 'dod ma/ khyim ma/ gtum mo/ mdud bral ma dang lnga'i ming gis bstan kyang*/ dus 'khor las ni/ sor skya phra mo lug la sogs pa lam gsum gyur pa rnams dang snar ma dang ni glang chen lce// rgyal ni drug pa min la rgyal 489)ba 'gro dang brgyad pa lambu ṣa ste dgu pa ku ha'o// bcu pa'i grangs ni dung can ma gang mi yi bdag po bde ba'i mthar ni byang sems sa bon 'dzag ces gsungs pa/ 'di rnams kyi ming don phan tshun sbyor ma shes tshe/ gang dang gang lags pa bstan par gsol zhing*/ mdor bsdu na/ don 'di rnams las 'phros te/ skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa'i zhag gcig gi rlung nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i nang nas ye shes kyi rlung drug brgya bdun bcu rtsa lnga bsdoms pa lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi zhag la 'char ba'i thabs shes kyi rgyud lha grangs dang bcas pa/ las rlung las dkar nag gi rtsis gzhung bde blag tu 'char ba/ khyad par tshul 'di'i smin grol gyi khrid dpe go sla zhing 'khyer bde la lag len dgongs can du ma song ba/ gsar rnying gcig tu 'bab pa zhig gnang bar gsol ba 'debs 490)pa'i dus da lta ston pa dngos su bzhugs pa'i skabs 'dir 'grub na/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba spyi dang*/ khyad par bdag rang gi phyi ma'i rten 'brel la legs tshogs kyi dpal du 'gyur bar go yang*/

khyed dam pa rnams/ sngon thub pa nyid mdo sde pad dkar gsung tshe phyi dro gcig la bar bskal lnga bcu'i yun du byin gyis brlabs pa lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul la ma nges mod kyang*/ bdag cag so skye byis pa rnams kyi snang ngor/ sku zhabs su yi ge pa zhig ma mchis tshe/ bstan bcos de lta bu mdzad par zhur ma spobs lags/ yang skal bzang dga' byed du/ dus 'khor gyi dbang la mtshon nas/ dge tshul slong du 'gyur tshul dang sa thob tshul sogs phebs pa'i skabs su/ dbang bzhi pas sa bcu gnyis pa dang skye dgu'i bdag po chen por 'gyur tshul gsungs pa 'di/ nang don 491)rang 'grel gnyis mtshungs par byung zhing*/ gzhan rnams las bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par bshad pa kho na byung bas ji ltar lags dang*/ bde mchog dril bu lugs las ni rtsa nyer bzhi dang sa'i rim pa sbyar nas bshad kyang*/ bcu pa chos sprin yan ma bstan par snang bas dgongs pa ci zhig yin the tshom dang*/ yang dus 'khor dbang gi skabs/ sa gsum pa thob byed dar dpyangs kyi dbang gi dag sbyor/ rlung bcu'i dri ma sbyong zhing*/ nus ma bcu'i dngos grub sgrub byed du gsungs na/ rlung bcu de rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung bcu la bzhed pa yin lags sam/ nus ma bcu po gang yin ma 'tshal ba dang*/ sbyang bzhi sbyong byed kyi skabs der 'dod chags bzhi po spang byar bshad pa'i dgongs don gang lags pa dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes kyi dbye ba'i skabs su gzugs sgra dri ro bzhi 492)ni dbang po dang yul shes sogs go sla yang gcig ma go bas/ gang la ngos 'dzin pa lags/ gzhan yang*/ gong du sngags kyi dge tshul slong gi 'phros las dogs pa'i gnas 'di ltar yang mchis te/ so thar gyi sdom pa 'di sngags kyi rten du dgos par gsungs tshul ni/ dbang chog rnams kyi sdom bzung gi skabs su/ tshul khrims kyis ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/

zhes pa dang*/ rgyud las kyang*/ dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ zhes sogs gsungs na/ so thar gyi sdom pa ma thob pas sngags la 'jug tu rung mi rung ji ltar dang 'di skabs kyi sdom bzung 'di dag gis so thar gyi go chod mi chod ji ltar lags/ 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras kyi gsung las/ nga rgas nas rab 493)byung byed pa ni// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i che ba yin// chos mgo 'jug log par mi dgongs 'tshal/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa slar so thar gyi bslab pa bzhes mkhan yang mang bar byung snang ba'i dgongs pa gang zhig lags/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i rten du yang so thar dgos par gsungs tshul ni/ so sor thar pa ris bdun gyi// rtag tu sdom gzhan ldan pa la// byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yi// skal ba yod kyi gzhan du min/ zhes lam sgron las gsungs pa bzhin nges par dgos pa lags sam/ gzhan yang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa'i dngos po ni za ma dang*/ ma ning dang*/ lha dang gsum la mi skye bar gsungs na/ de dag la mi skye ba'i rgyu gang yin pa dang*/ za ma zhes bya ba de spyir bu med la ngos 'dzin 494)mkhan yod rung*/ de ni min par gsal te skye dgu'i bdag mo sogs dgra bcom mang po dang*/ dge slong ma dpal mo sogs bud med rab byung mang mod kyi/ des na za ma dngos de gang zhig lags pa dang*/ ma ning zhes pa pho mo'i dbang po dang mi ldan pa zhig yin lags sam/ lha la sdom pa mi skye na/ brgya byin ni sa gsum pa'i byang sems yin par mdo las gsungs na/ sdom pa mi skye ba'i lha de gang zhig yin lags pa sogs kyi the tshom ma rig pa'i mun tshogs bsal bar mdzad du gsol/ yang*/ mgon po byams pa'i smon lam phyi nang du/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin dang gsum gsungs ba'i nang tshan gyi/ rdo rje lta bu de ni bstan bcos thar rgyan sogs nas/

sa bcu rgyun mtha'i ye shes de yin par gsungs snang ba/ de ltar na 'dir shes 495)rab kyi smon lam du 'ong thang ba la/ bsam gtan gyi smon lam du byung ba'i dgongs pa ji ltar lags dang sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin zhes pa/ 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar med bzhin snang ba'i cho 'phrul du rtogs pa la 'jug par go bas de ltar lags sam/ dpa' bar 'gro ba'i ting 'dzin de gang yin pa gtan nas ma go bas gang yin gyi phebs gsal zhu ba dang*/ sgom gyi skabs su/ lhag mthong zhes pa'i ming 'di bdag cag so skye byis pa rnams mgo 'khor ba'i ched dgongs pa can gyi sgrar gsungs pa yin nam snyam du go ma bde ba zhig dang*/ yid la mi byed pa zhes pa'i sgra 'di dgongs min du go na'ang*/ gang yang yid la mi byed do snyam na ni yid byed tshabs che shos su 'gyur zhing*/ ci yang ma dran par brjod pa 'dra ba de ni hwa shang gi sgom ltar stong 496)pa nyi tshe ba'i phyogs su lhung bar 'gyur phyir/ 'di yang dka' ba'i gnas shig tu byung lags/ ༈ yang*/ hwa shang gi lta ba blun sgom dran med gnyid thug po lta bu zhes chad lta'i skyon can du gsungs pa 'di dang*/ rgyud 'grel dag tu/ gnyid stug po shin tu sems med pa ni chos kyi sku'o/ zhes gsungs pa/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par gang gis 'byed pa lags/ ༈ rje btsun mar pa de nyid bal yul li sho ka ra na bzhugs skabs su dag snang la mkha' 'gros gdan drangs nas lho phyogs dpal gyi ri bor bram ze chen po sa ra ha dang mjal pa'i tshe phyag chen gyi man ngag gnang ba'i rtsa tshig der/ ji skad du/ rtsa ba khyim na gnas pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung*// sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis// sems la lhan pa gdab tu med/ ces gsungs pa 'di la/ bdag gi blun tshod 497)du/ rtsa ba khyim du gnas pa ni kun gzhi nyid dang*/ yid kyi rnam shes btson du bzung ba ni/

rnam rtog gam 'gyur ba rang mgo yan du mi 'chor bar dran pas zin pa dang*/ sgom pa shes pa phyi ma yis/ zhes skad cig phyi ma'i sgom blo'i rtog pa des/ sems la lhan pa gdab tu med pa ni/ snga ma rnam rtog ngos zin pa de las slar sgom logs su btsal rgyu med ces pa'i brda go bas de ltar yin min gyi don 'grel sku drin skyong ba mkhyen/ ༈ yang*/ skabs 'dir 'pho ba'i gdams ngag gi dogs gnas 'ga' zhig snyan du gsol te/ de yang*/ pha rol po de'i lus lhar gsal ba'i nang dbus su rtsa dbu ma mtshan nyid bzhi ldan dang snying gar rnam shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ yig gi rnam pa de rang nyid kyi ting 'dzin dang hika gis spor bar gsungs na/ ding sang la la'i phyag 498)bzhes su phung po'i mdun du/ nye 'khor sogs thams cad tshogs pa'i sar/lha sku rtsa yig sogs dmigs rim rnams skad gsangs mthon pos dmigs pa sprod pa'i srol 'dug pa de la gsang sngags gsang sgrogs kyi nyes pa yod med ji ltar dang*/ pha rol po la lhar bskyed nas rnam shes spar ba'i mjug tu skyed rim bsdu ba sogs dgos sam mi dgos dang*/ lhar ma gsal bar rnam shes spar du rung mi rung ci lta bu dang*/ de'i tshe rang nyid kyang lha ru gsal dgos mi dgos dang*/ pha rol po'i rnam shes spor bar byed pa la rang nyid kyi dmigs pa ma gtad pa'i thabs ni nam kyang ma mchis la/ gtad ches na rang yang lhan du 'pho bar nyen pa'am/ mthar yang tshe la gzan pa sogs bshad 'dug pas/ des na 'di dag gi the tshom gyi gnas rnams dkrol ba'i bka' drin zhu/ yang zhu 'bul gyi don tshan gcig na/ 'phags pa'i gnas brtan 499)bcu drug 'di dag gi khungs dang lo rgyus sogs kyi yig cha khungs thub zhig ni ma rnyed la/ gal te rnyed kyang dmus long gi mar gyi dpe don bzhin 'gyur phyir/ dogs gcod zhu rgyur/ ston pa'i nyan thos rnams kyi nang nas 'di rnams bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su ched gnyer du byon pa'i rgyu gang lags pa dang*/

༈ mtshan gnas brtan du brjod lugs kyis/ grub mtha' yang gnas brtan pa'i sde nyid lags sam/ sangs rgyas stong thams cad la gnas brtan bcu drug re 'byon nam shākya'i bstan pa gcig pur lags/ ngag rgyun 'ga' zhig tu/ gnas bcu rgya gar rgya nag lugs gnyis dang*/ hwa shang yod pa 'di rgya nag lugs yin pa dang*/ gnas brtan rnams hwa shang gi bu yin par bshad pa sogs sna tshogs dang*/ gzhan yang bdag ni sngar/ hwa shang zhes pa mi gcig kho nar go yod na'ang*/ da lam skal bzang dga' byed kyi 500)phebs nang du/ hwa shang zhig la sgom gyi man ngag bslab tshul byung bas nang*/ hwa shang gi sde rigs bzhin yod pa lags sam/ lar gnas bcu lugs gnyis tha dad yod nges yin na ni mtshan sogs kyang tha dad du 'ong thang yang mi snang ba dang*/ sgra gcan 'dzin ni ston pa'i sras yin tshe hwa shang gi bu yin don mi 'dug pa sogs kyi/ ngag rgyun la ni yid brtan mi thub par go la/ rje btsun gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i chos 'byung chen mor/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rtogs brjod lung 'dren du mdzad pa der/ skye dgu rnams tshe lo yar 'phel gyi bdun brgya pa la/ gnas brtan thams cad dngos su byon te thub pa'i bka' ma lus pa rin po che'i mchod rten du bsdus pa la phyag dang mchod pa sogs rgya cher mdzad pa'i mthar gnas brtan rnams rang rang gi thugs ka nas rang byung gi me phyungs te mya ngan 501)las 'das pa'i sku gdung tsam yang med par mdzad cing*/ mchod rten de yang 'og tu rim gyi nub nas gser gyi sa gzhi la bzhugs par 'gyur tshul gsungs pa 'di dang*/ padma bka'i thang yig tu/ shākya'i bstan pa 'grib tshul lung bstan pa'i skabs su/ tshe lo bcu pa la ni mthil du thug ces gsungs tshe/ 'di gnyis mi mthun par byung bas/ bstan pa'i gnas tshad sogs ji ltar nges pa lags/ ༈ gnas bstan rnams kyi zhar la dharmā tā nges par 'ong ba'i rgyu mtshan yang gang zhig lags/

'di dag gi 'phros la brten pas 'dul ba'i skabs don 'ga' zhig zhu bar bgyi na/ spyir/ rab tu byung ba la chos gos rnam gsum du grags pa'i gsum po gang gang lags pa dang*/ de bzhin du mkho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum po ji ltar dang*/ yang sngags nang pa'i gzhung 502)lugs kyi skye 'chi sku gsum gyi ngo bor lhun gyis grub tshul las/ skye ba sprul sku'i dag sbyor gyi skabs der/ mngal gyi khru ma chos gos nyid ces sogs gsungs pa las snam sbyar gyi sgros mi 'dug tshe/ rnam sbyar chos gos kyi khongs su 'du ba lags sam/ khyad par du/ nyan thos sde pa bzhi'i dbye ba bshad skabs su de yang*/ phal chen sde pa la/ snam phran nyi shu rtsa lnga nas/ bdun gyi bar 'dod dung gis mtshan/ zhes pa dang*/ thams cad yod smra'i sde la/ snam phran dgu nas nyer lnga'i bar/ zhes dang*/ gnas brtan pa'i sde par/ snam phran lnga nas nyer gcig bar/ zhes dang*/ mang bkur gnas brtan pa dang mtshungs/ zhes bshad 'dug par/ yang*/ gu ru rin po che padma 'byung gnas kyi bzhed pa mkhas pa klong chen pas ngal gso skor gsum gyi gzhung du gsungs pa ni/ sde bzhi'i dbye tshul dang*/ snam phran gyi grangs sogs kyang gong 503)gi 'di dang cung mi mthun par 'dug pa/ gang ltar yang snam phran glegs bu sogs la ngos 'dzin mi gcig pa mang zhing shin tu go dka' bar byung bas/ gang ltar lags pa dang*/ kha dog kyang gnas brtan gyi sku rnams la ni sngo ljang sogs sna tshogs yong 'dug pa de ltar rung ba lags sam/ de bzhin du sham thabs dang gding ba sogs kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ lhung bzed kyang dge slong pho mo so so la tshad tha dad du dgos par grags na ji ltar dang*/ chab ril la dbyibs mi 'dra ba gnyis snang ba'i khyad don dang chab len pa'i dgos pa ni kha zas kyi ro la zhen pa gcod thabs yin zer ba thos kyang*/ de ltar na snga chab len pa sogs dgos med du thal tshe/

dgos ched ci lta bu dang*/ lar yang rab tu byung ba'i rtags dang cha lugs la khyad par gyi dgos don dang phan 504)yon gang lags pa dang*/ ༈ stan la 'dug pa dang*/ zas kyi dus su lham 'bud pa'i phyag srol gyi dgos ched ci yin pa dang*/ ༈ 'dul ba nas gos bug pa can nam sbubs can gyi rigs spong bar gsungs pa'i dgos ched ji ltar dang*/ lham la yu ba mi byed pa yang de la dgongs pa lags sam/ de ltar na/ ding sang ser mo ba spyi'i ring 'gag dang*/ sham thabs dkyus ma 'di dag bug pa can du 'gro'am mi 'gro sogs ji ltar lags/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ sngags kyi rgyud 'grel dag tu/ sde pa bzhi po 'di nang gi rtsa 'dab 'khor lo bzhi la sbyor ba dang*/ lha'i zhal bzhi dang sbyor tshul sogs kyang gsungs snang ba la the tshom byung bas/ mi shes rmongs pa'i mun pa sel ba zhig bdag dang ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag la thugs rjes dgongs te gnang bar gsol ba 'debs so/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ 505)phran bu'i 'dod don gsol ba ni/ zhwa lu lo chen gyis mdzad pa'i dag yig za ma tog dang*/ dag yig gzhan yang gang la bltas kyang*/ mgo can gyi skabs su/ dza yig sa mgo can 'di ma bstan 'dug pa dang*/ de mtshungs/ gsung rab chen mo dbu can thams cad la'ang lar mi 'dug cing*/ bshur ma la ni sngar gyi dpe rnying shin tu dag pa rnams la'ang sa dza 'di nyid nges par bris 'dug pa/ bzab bshur gnyis la sdebs tha dad 'ong par mi srid phyir/ tshul 'di ji ltar lags pa'i the tshom dang*/ ༈ yang*/ sngags klog gi skabs su/ snar thang lo tsās mdzad pa sogs gang mthong kun la/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha rnams ma gtogs gzhan rtsegs ma thams cad 'phral te 'don dgos par bshad na/ ngag rgyun la/ ksha/ tstsha/ 'di dag ma 'phral 506)bar 'don pa'i srol dang*/ gzhan yang*/ hya/ bhyo/ a mṛ ta/ shu n+ya ta/ 'di rnams la yang sngags klog ltar na/ he/ bha yo/ a mir ta/ shu ne ta/ ces pa lta bur brjod dgos mdog kha yang*/

ding sang phal cher ni/ ha ya/ 'byo/ a mri ta/ shu nāe ta ces pa 'dra bar klog 'dug pas shin tu the tshom che zhing*/ 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi 'don lugs yid mi ches pa mang po zhig snang ba snyan du zhur ma langs lags/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ phran bu'i skabs don du/ chos pa rnams log pa'i 'tsho ba lnga po spang dgos par gsungs pa las log 'tsho lnga de gang gang yin pa dang*/ ༈ yang*/ thams cad kyi kha gtam la ni 'jig rten chos brgyad che chung sogs zer bzhin du/ brgyad po gang yin pa ni go mkhan dkon pas/ 'di'i nges gsal dang*/ ༈ yang*/ khams gsum/ sa gsum srid 507)pa gsum/ 'jig rten gsum zhes pa 'di dag gcig gam tha dad pa'i tshul gang lags pa sogs/ de ltar bdag 'dra'i rnam rtog gang shar thams cad yig gzugs su bkod pa 'di 'dra ba rnams/ zhabs pad dam pa'i drung du 'bul bar mi 'os kyang*/ snyigs dus phyogs mtha'i btsun pa bdag sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i yul dang re sa gzhan du ma rnyed pa'i sdug yus kyi snyan du phul thal ba la dgongs klong zab mo 'khrel ba med ngos nas/ sangs rgyas la mdzad rgyu sems can gyi don las mi mnga' phyir bdag sogs kyi skal ba dang 'tshams pa'i lan gyi rim pa ji ltar dgos pa/ thugs dam rin po che'i sad rkyen mi 'gyur ba'i skabs bstun du zhu zhes zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ ༈ 'di yan gyi lan du/ chos tshul sna tshogs las brtsams te 'bel gtam du bgyis pa'i rabs me tog chun 'phyang zhes bya ba'i dpe tshan gcig yod do// 508)༈ bstan dang 'gro ba'i srog shing rdo rje 'dzin// srid zhi'i 'ching ba gcod pa'i mgon po mchog /gang gi zhabs sen bkra shis 'khor lo'i dpal// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lte bar dgod du gsol// zhes pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa sngon du btang nas/ skabs 'dir gsol don/ ༈ gsang sngags kyi bsnyen sgrub grangs tshad bshad pa'i skabs dag tu/ 'bum phrag man dang dung phyur yan la ni thams cad bzhed tshul mthun tshe go bde na'ang*/

bye ba dang sa ya 'di gnyis rtsis dpe sogs mang por snga rting 'dren lugs mi mthun pa kho nar byung bas/ gang yin the tshom dang*/ ༈ bsnyen sgrub gang byed kyi bsnyen tshad de'i bcu cha'i grangs dang mtshungs pa'i bsnyen pa kha skong gi sbyin sreg 'bul dgos par gsungs na/ de nyid dper na bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gcig 509)bzla ba na/ 'bum gyi bcu cha ni khri yin tshe/ sbyin sreg khri phrag gcig 'bul dgos par 'gyur ba de la/ cho ga tshar gcig gi khongs nas sreg rdzas yams shing la sogs khri phrag phul bas rung ba yin nam/ cho ga tshar khri tsho nges par 'gro dgos sam ji ltar lags/ ༈ sreg rdzas khri phrag phul bas chog pa yin na'ang*/ 'jig rten gyi me lha dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs gnyis kar 'bum dgos pa lags sam/ dkyil 'khor pa kho na la grangs tshang bar phul bas rung ba lags sam ci ltar lags/ ༈ mchod rdzas dang sreg rdzas gnyis ka grangs tshang ba dgos sam sreg rdzas kho na yin pa dang*/ ༈ lar yang*/ sbyin sreg gi skabs 'dir dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma skyed pa'i gong der 'jig rten me lha zhig nges par bskyed pa'i phyag srol snang ba 'di la 510)dgos pa gang zhig lags/ khyad par phag mo'i sbyin sreg mdzad mkhan phal cher/ me thab tu chos 'byung gi dkyil 'khor bris pa la 'jig rten me lha bskyed par mdzad pa 'di la shin tu the tshom byung lags shing*/ yang*/ dpal mkha' spyod pa'i slob ma lha'i ming can gyis mdzad pa'i phag mo'i zin bris la ni 'jig rten me ltar bskyed par bshad mi 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ bdag blun po'i 'ol tshod la 'di ltar yang dran te/ me'i mchod sbyin gyi skabs 'dir sngon du me lha nges par bskyed dgos pa zhig yin na/ 'byung ba gzhan gsum la yang mtshungs phyir/ dper na/ sātstsha lta bur yang dang por sa bdag the se sogs su bskyed par 'gyur bas/ des na tshul 'di'i dgos don ci lta bu zhig lags/

༈ yang*/ rab gnas dang sbyin sreg la la'i 511)gzhung du/ tsā ru'i bza' ba zhes bya ba dgos pa 'di nyid tshogs 'khor dngos ni min par snang tshe/ 'di'i ngo bo dang nges tshig dgos ched sogs ji ltar lags/ ༈ gzhan yang*/ tshe 'das kyi ming byang la sbyang ba dang khrus chog sogs thams cad dkyil 'khor lho sgo'i phyogs kho nar byed cing*/ ming yang lho sgo cho ga zhes su grags par gda' ba/ sgo gzhan du bya mi rung ba'am/ lho sgo rang du byed dgos pa'i gtan tshigs ci zhig la gsal pa dang*/ ༈ gang zag phal pa'i rigs 'chi ba kun zhag phyed dang bzhir rnam shes brgyal zhing*/ zhag grangs de nyid tshang ba na brgyal sangs pa yin no zhes grags pa dang*/ dbus gtsang gi yul phyogs su ni/ zhag phyed dang bzhi 'das mtshams der bla ma'am 'dren mchog mkhan zhig gis khrus chog dang dbang bskur sogs byed thub na mi thub lta bu'i srol snang 512)bas/ zhag grangs de lta bu'i nges pa can 'byung ba lags sam/ yang*/ rje nyid kyi mdzad pa'i bar do'i spyi don du/ thim rim rnams bya rdzogs kyi skad cig ma'i yun du gsungs pa'i/ bya rdzogs kyi yun tshad la/ rtsis kyi gsang ba stag rna can gyi mdo las ni/ dper na/ bud med bal mi skyen mi bul ba zhig gis/ bal 'dab sna nar gyis drangs te/ slar 'phang la dkris pa'i bar gyi yun tshad de la bya rdzogs kyi skad cig tu bshad cing*/ dus mtha'i skad cig ni/ gyad kyis se gol gtog pa'i yun gcig la gsungs na/ 'di skabs kyi bya rdzogs kyang gong gi 'di ka dang mtshungs pa lags sam/ bzhed tshul gzhan mchis pa lags/ ༈ yang zhu don gsung rab rnams su/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang*/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis so sor gsungs snang tshe/ de gnyis 513)kyi dbye ba gang gis 'byed pa dang*/ ༈ sangs rgya ba dang*/ 'tshang rgya ba'i tshig zur 'di gnyis ni 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam dbye yin nam snyam pas/

de ltar yin lags sam/ las rgyu 'bras kyi skabs rnams su/ gang zhig rgyu 'bras kyi tshul ji lta ba go bzhin du spang blang mi byed par khyad du gsod pa dag ni rnam smin rab tu lci bar gzhi grub mod kyang*/ de ltar ma yin pa'i 'gro ba mi lus tsam po ba kla klo lta bu'am/ dud 'gro'i rigs gcan zan la sogs pa dang*/ mdor na dge sdig gi snang ba ye med pa dag gis srog gcod sogs byas pa'i sdig pa'i rnam smin gong ma de dang khyad med du 'byung ngam 'on te cung zad khyad mchis sam ji lta bu lags/ ༈ gzhan yang thor bu'i zhu mchid la/ gtor chog sogs mang por 514)gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin rgyal po la// spyan 'dren 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ zhes 'byung ba'i skabs kyi gtan pa med pa zhes pa'i don 'jug pa ma go bas gang zhig lags/

'di yan gyi dri lan ni thor bu'i dri lan gyi dpe tshan de nyid yin la/ 'dir ma 'dus pa'i dri ba'i tshig phra rgyas phal cher ni dris lan nyid la 'khod pa'i gshis kyis 'dir ma bris pa lags so// dge'o//
